question: What maintenance is required for GCM Sports Safety Nets after installation?
answer:
GCM Sports Safety Nets are engineered for exceptional durability and minimal maintenance, thanks to their premium construction. Crafted from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and thoroughly UV stabilized, our nets are built to withstand Chennai's challenging weather conditions, ensuring long-term performance and safety. We back this quality with a robust 3-5 year warranty.

While our nets require little active upkeep, we strongly recommend periodic visual inspections—ideally every three to six months. During these checks, closely examine the entire net for any signs of wear and tear, such as cuts, abrasions, fraying, or any loosening of the netting, ropes, or anchoring points. Pay particular attention to areas prone to high impact or friction. Promptly addressing any minor issues can significantly extend the lifespan and effectiveness of your safety net.
